title: Real-account live-cron smoke fires cronFired at least once against a real Cloudflare Worker
asA: operator validating platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers v1.0.0 against a real Cloudflare account
iWant: the real-account-scheduled-smoke probe to schedule a per-minute cron on a real Worker and assert cronFired fires within a bounded wait
soThat: the shipped scheduled() surface is proven against the vendor's global cron scheduler, not only against wrangler dev

acceptanceCriteria.description: The real-account-scheduled-smoke probe, when CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT=true and the paired CF_ACCOUNT_ID / CF_WORKER_NAME / CF_API_TOKEN env vars are set, polls the Cloudflare Workers Analytics or observability API for the named Worker every 5 seconds, waits bounded 90 seconds for a scheduled event to appear at least once, and returns aggregateVerdict: pass on observation. Without CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT the probe records accountBoundSkipped: true and aggregates to pass per spec section 3.5.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real Cloudflare account with the paired env vars, or no such account and CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT unset
acceptanceCriteria.then: with the account: a scheduled event is observed within 90s and the probe passes. Without the account: the probe records accountBoundSkipped: true and exits 0.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bounded-wait timeout on the real-account probe: if the 90-second poll observes no scheduled event, the probe returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" with a reason field naming CRON_REAL_ACCOUNT_NO_FIRE, the observed poll count and the last response body from the Cloudflare observability API.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real Cloudflare account with the paired env vars, and a Worker whose cron trigger fails to fire for 90+ seconds
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe polls the Analytics or observability API every 5 seconds up to 90 seconds
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" naming CRON_REAL_ACCOUNT_NO_FIRE and the last response body

acceptanceCriteria.description: Partial env-var configuration: with CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT=true set but CF_API_TOKEN missing, the probe refuses BEFORE making any API request with a named error kind CF_MISSING_TOKEN naming the missing env var. Same for CF_ACCOUNT_ID or CF_WORKER_NAME missing.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe refuses with CF_MISSING_TOKEN naming the missing variable and exits non-zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: Non-2xx API response: if the Cloudflare Analytics or observability API returns a non-2xx status (401, 403, 429 or 5xx) during polling, the probe surfaces the observed status and response body and returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" with reason CF_ANALYTICS_HTTP_ERROR. The probe does not retry on 4xx; it retries once on 5xx before failing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real-account probe run where the Analytics API returns 403
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict:"fail" with reason CF_ANALYTICS_HTTP_ERROR, HTTP status and body in the record
